transcript: 5 things you can actually do to improve your gut health. So many people believe healing the gut means buying more supplements or chasing the newest greens powder. But true healing doesn't come from a capsule. It comes from returning to balance with nature. 1. Eat more fiber. Both insoluble and soluble fibers are gentle sweepers of the body. They keep your bowels moving and your energy flowing. 2. Eat prebiotic foods. Garlic, onions, bananas, oats. These are sacred foods that feed the good bacteria inside your gut, allowing them to grow strong and protect you. 3. Drink enough water. When you increase fiber, water becomes essential. It is the river that carries everything through. Without it, your inner stream becomes still and heavy. 4. Move your body. A short walk after meals awakens digestion. Movement brings warmth, blood and life to your internal organs. 5. Calm your mind. The brain and gut are one conversation. When the mind is restless, the stomach suffers. When the mind is calm, the body heals. Stress, anxiety, even sadness, all echo through your belly. And remember, sleep. Sleep is your body's deepest form of healing. Without it, cortisol rises, digestion slows and balance fades. You do not need powders or pills to heal. You need awareness, simplicity and daily rhythm.
